# sherpa-radial-chart

A donut / pie / arc for part-to-whole data.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | chart |
| Figma | Donut Chart |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-radial-chart/sherpa-radial-chart.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-radial-chart/sherpa-radial-chart.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-radial-chart/sherpa-radial-chart.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-radial-chart/sherpa-radial-chart.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-radial-chart/sherpa-radial-chart.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-container><sherpa-data-viz-header slot="header" data-heading="Customers by plan"></sherpa-data-viz-header><sherpa-radial-chart data-sublabel="customers"></sherpa-radial-chart></sherpa-container>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-radial-chart`:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Pro",
    "value": 12,
    "colorIndex": 1
  },
  {
    "label": "Team",
    "value": 8,
    "colorIndex": 2
  },
  {
    "label": "Free",
    "value": 3,
    "colorIndex": 3
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-aggregate` | `count` `sum` `mean` `min` `max` `distinct` | `count` | count \| sum \| mean \| min \| max \| distinct, per value |
| `data-bands` | text |  |  |
| `data-bucket` | `day` `month` `year` |  |  |
| `data-field` | text |  | the number that aggregate reads |
| `data-inner` | text |  | hole size, a FRACTION of the outer radius (0–1). A pie ignores it — a pie has no hole by definition. |
| `data-label` | text |  | centre big text |
| `data-legend` | `horizontal` `vertical` |  | horizontal (default: below the ring) \| vertical (beside it) |
| `data-over-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-segment-field` | text |  | ASKED of its provider: one slice per value of this field |
| `data-sublabel` | text |  | centre small text |
| `data-sweep` | number | `360` | how far it runs, in degrees. 360 is a full ring; a gauge is this ring stopped short — start 270, sweep 180. |
| `data-sweep-start` | number |  | where the arc begins, clockwise degrees from 12 o'clock |
| `data-type` | `donut` `pie` | `donut` | donut \| pie (pie fills to the centre, no hole) |
| `data-where` | text |  |  |

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `slice-click` | `{ index: number; label: string; value: number }` | A slice is clicked. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | text | heading above the ring |
| `legend` | legend | an optional legend: below the ring, or beside it with data-legend="vertical" |
